objective: Answer an interview question at the level of a hands-on practitioner.

sources.title: Anthropic: Demystifying evals for AI agents
Anthropic: How we built our multi-agent research system (2025)

followUp.question: Map your agent evaluation onto a validation plan and gate review you have run. Where does it differ?
rubric: repeated trials because outputs vary|non deterministic unlike hardware
regression on every change|prompt or model change reruns tests

transfer.scenario: Your team's agent passed its eval last month. Since then the model provider shipped a new version and two tools changed. What do you run, and what would block the update?
rubric: regression suite|rerun the eval|same task set
compare cost and latency per task
safety cases must stay at zero|no unauthorized actions
pre set thresholds block release|release gate

question: How would you evaluate an AI agent before and after it goes into production?

mustCover: tasks from real cases|real failures|realistic tasks|production logs|real conversations
check the end state|task success|final state|outcome in the system
trajectory review|read transcripts|tool calls checked|policy violations|path review
repeated trials|several runs per task|pass hat k|consistency across runs|run multiple times
cost per task|tokens per task|latency per task|cost and latency
thresholds set before running|release gate|pass bar in advance
monitoring after launch|tracing|production traces|sample transcripts|escalation rate
strongSignals: calibrate the judge against human labels|judge calibration|human labels
sandbox or recorded tool responses|mocked tools
grade the outcome|outcome over path|any valid path

followUps.question: How many tasks and trials do you need to start?
rubric: grow from production logs|add new failures over time
small sets give wide uncertainty|confidence interval

followUps.question: How do you know your LLM judge is right?
rubric: compare with human labels|calibrate|agreement with people

followUps.question: What would make you roll back after launch?
rubric: unauthorized action|safety breach|wrong credits or refunds
